props.title: Frequently Asked Questions
props.subtitle: Find answers to the questions we hear most often.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Reach out through our contact page and our team will guide you through the next steps.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve customers across Bangladesh through our dealer and support network.

items.question: How can I get support?
items.answer: Visit the Contact Us page for phone, email, and office details, and our team will respond promptly.

items.question: Do you offer guidance after purchase?
items.answer: Yes, our support team is available to help with any questions after you start using our products or services.

props.title: Still have questions?
props.subtitle: Get in touch and we'll be happy to help.

cards.title: How long does delivery take?
cards.description: Inside Dhaka orders usually arrive in 1-2 working days. Other districts take 3-5 working days.

cards.title: How can I track my order?
cards.description: Sign in and open My Orders to see the live status of every order you have placed.

cards.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
cards.description: Yes, as long as the order has not been shipped. Contact support as soon as possible.

cards.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
cards.description: We accept Cash on Delivery, bKash, Nagad and major credit and debit cards.

cards.title: Is online payment secure?
cards.description: Yes. All online payments are processed through encrypted, trusted payment gateways.

cards.title: What is your return policy?
cards.description: You can return unused products within 7 days of delivery if they are in their original packaging.

cards.title: When will I get my refund?
cards.description: Refunds are processed within 5-7 working days after we receive and inspect the returned item.
